items.title: German Chancellor Merz calls state election a 'disaster' for his party but vows to stay on
items.description: Exit polls show damaging losses for Merz's centre-right CDU party in the states of Berlin and Mecklenburg-Vorpommern.

items.title: Largest attack on Moscow sees Ukraine fire hundreds of drones, mayor says
items.description: Moscow's mayor says 450 drones were downed during the overnight barrage, in which two people died.

items.title: Ed Sheeran admits 'mistakes' at first show since Macklemore controversy
items.description: The singer spoke about Israel and Gaza after Macklemore was dropped from his tour for making pro-Palestinian remarks on stage.

items.title: Trump says triumphal arch will be military complex with drones and snipers
items.description: Trump said the updated plans were at the request of the US military and for national security purposes.

items.title: Man, 82, dies after beach fight with 76-year-old over sunlounger in Greece
items.description: One eyewitness said the scene was so chaotic that screaming could be heard from the other end of the beach.

items.title: Sister of Pakistan's ex-PM Imran Khan arrested
items.description: Aleema Khanum is accused of mobilising her brother’s supporters ahead of country-wide protests.

items.title: Houthis say they targeted Saudi capital with ballistic missiles
items.description: A reported strike on a fuel depot at Riyadh airport caused delays on Saturday, as Saudi Arabia says it shot down a ballistic missile aimed at the capital.

items.title: Converse pulls 'deeply upsetting' advert after backlash
items.description: Social media users say an image from the brand's Instagram account resembled a KKK hood and hanging.

items.title: Nato welcomes Greenland deal as Trump says it will give US 'permanent security control'
items.description: Denmark and the US have reached an agreement after months of threats from Donald Trump to annex the territory.

items.title: Google's Gemini AI hacked three companies in security test
items.description: The AI model accessed the internet and guessed credentials to three websites, a Google official told the BBC.

items.title: Trump says US will form 'AI Force' and appoint an artificial intelligence tsar
items.description: The president said his administration "will not in any way hinder or stifle the growth" amid amid warnings about the emergent technology.

items.title: Grim discoveries of murdered women spark fear in South Africa
items.description: Dineo Motapane is one of nine recent victims whose deaths have left a nation traumatised over the level of violence against women.
